segments.text: A second-year student at Akiba Metropolitan Senior High School. Due to her father's job, she has repeatedly transferred schools. Haruho has a slightly shy and reserved personality.
Translation of Girls-Style's profile of her.

A third-year student of Sensui Prefectural Technical High School. He is hot-blooded and loves sports. Haruho met Tetsu when she was in the fourth grade as transfer student while she was in Miyagi Prefecture.
Partial translations of both Photograph Journey's profiles of him.

A second-year student at Chura Prefectural Senior High School of Fishery. He's a pure-hearted surfer boy who's not good with women. Haruho met Kojirou two years prior to the events of Photograh Journey, when she was staying at her grandmother's place at Okinawa during the summer holidays.
Partial translations of both Photograph Journey's profiles of him.

A mathematics teacher at Nakoya Prefectural High School. He's a man who's hard to figure out, and goes about his dealings at his own pace, in his own way. Haruho met Yukari when she was in her first year of high school during spring, having transferred into the class Yukari was the homeroom teacher of after moving to the Aichi Prefecture.
Partial translations of both Photograph Journey's profiles of him.

A first-year at Genbu Urban Prefectural Senior High School. Excellent in martial and traditional Japanese performing arts, Shizuki is a very sadistic boy from a distinguished family. Haruho met Shizuki when she was second-year junior high school student. While on a school excursion, she became lost in a traditional Japanese garden, which turned out to belong to the Kujou house.
Partial translations of both Photograph Journey's profiles of him.

A third-year student of Suzuo Academy Senior High School. Karen is a shy and fragile boy with a weak body. Due to his weak constitution that lead him to being absent from school often, plus his shy nature, he's often on his own. He's good at listening to others but not talking about himself. When Karen is healthy, he enjoys his only hobby- taking pictures while going on a walk.

Haruho met Karen when she was a sixth-grade primary school student. Around that time, Haruho became ill and collapsed, which required her to get hospitalised. When she felt better, she wandered around the hospital courtyard and met Karen. They became friends and swapped books with each other.
Partial translations of both Photograph Journey's profiles of him.

A third-year student of Oumine Private Middle School. A fashionable, (over)confident boy who loves freedom above all else, and is skilled in language studies. Thanks to his tallness for his age and stylishness, he was scouted by an agent when walking around in town and became a model. Haruho met Takara when she was in her second year of junior high school. Haruho's family had just moved to Kanagawa Prefecture, and reading at her local park became one of her everyday pastimes. There, she met Takara, and gradually, they chatted more and more.
Partial translations of both Photograph Journey's profiles of him.

A second-year high school student at Seigetsu Private Academy. He loves the stars, and is an obstinate and logical person. Showing no interest in anything other than the stars, Yuuto is a stubborn quibbler. He doesn't do what others tell him to and doesn't mix well with his peers, so he's left to put up a front by saying he "likes being alone". He doesn't realise that he has a somewhat lonely side to him.

Haruho meets Yuuto when she was in her first year of junior high school. She approached Yuuto during break time when she saw him reading an astronomical photography book. She seriously listened to what he had to say about the stars. From that point on, she talked about and observed the stars with Yuuto.
Partial translations of both Photograph Journey's profiles of him.

A third-year student at Hokkaido Kumakawa Agricultural High School. Though sharp-tongued, Kei is a kind and gentle boy at heart. Hokkaido is also Haruho's birthplace, and was her place of residence until her third year in primary school. Kei is her one-year-senior childhood friend. Since they were neighbours, they came to know each other through their families.
Partial translations of both Photograph Journey's profiles of him.

A second-year student at Hatowa Private Business Senior High School. He's a charismatic and cheeky fashion magazine model. Mizuki always has people around him, and is a central figure in his class. Haruho met him during the summer holidays when she was in her third year of junior high school. She was staying with her grandmother in Okinawa, where she meets Mizuki. Mizuki had come from Nagasaki Prefecture just for a visit.
Partial translations of both Photograph Journey's profiles of him.

A first-year student of Ikari First Prefectural Senior High School. He seems like a plain and ordinary boy, but he's actually a hot-blooded member of a rock band. Normally, he leaves a gloomy impression upon those he comes across, but when he's with people who are close to him, he becomes cheerful. Ryouhei has an excellent sense of sound and put his talents to great use with his band. He's the guitarist, but he also writes lyrics and composes the music.

Haruho met her underclassman, Ryouhei, when she was in her third year of junior high school. They became acquaintances when her family moved to Shizuoka. One day, she spots Ryouhei singing at the beach. His singing voice captured her heart, and since then, she often went to the beach listen to him sing.
Partial translations of both Photograph Journey's profiles of him.

segments.text: A foreign exchange student from England who loves Japan, Richard is homestaying with Haruho's family. A gentleman, he's supportive when it comes to Haruho's love life.
Based on Photograph Journey's profile of him.

A second-year student attending Ryuugamine Private Senior High School, he's a sensitive boy. Yaichi and Haruho met when she was in her fifth year of primary school. Having just moved moved to Kagawa Prefecture, she couldn't approach her new classmates to make friends. When she was upset, Yaichi approached and cheered her up. From then on, they became friends.
Partial translations of both Photograph Journey's profiles of him.

A second-year student attending Suzuran Private High School, Nagi is a mysterious boy whose thoughts are hard to determine. Haruho and Nagi met one another when she was in her fourth year of primary school, while she was in the Miyazaki Prefecture. Nagi came from the Miyagi Prefecture to Miyazaki at the time due to family reasons.
Partial translations of both Photograph Journey's profiles of him.
